hooks.text: Every fifty-two years, the Aztecs extinguished every single fire in their empire.
Would the sun rise again after the priests cut open the captive?
To keep the world alive, the empire went dark for one night.

title: Why Did the Aztecs Put Out Every Fire in 1507? 😳
description: At the 1507 New Fire Ceremony, hearths went dark for one night in a ritual repeated every 52 years. The video uses a labeled 2023 Tenochtitlan reconstruction and a labeled 1945 Diego Rivera mural as illustrations.
